assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document

Orchestrator-specific concepts with no Orchestra equivalent (e.g. partitions, backfills, backoff/jitter retry strategies) are dropped and explicitly flagged as a manual-review item, rather than force-fit into an existing field or silently ignored
Tags carried over from the source are placed on individual tasks, never on the enclosing task group/stage (TaskGroupModel has no tags field)
